name_zh: 不丹国民幸福总值/幸福治理/可持续发展/独特发展模式
description_zh: 不丹国民幸福总值 (GNH) 是一种替代GDP的发展指标，强调精神幸福、环境保护、文化保护、良好治理，通过宪法保障、政策制定、国际推广，探索不同于西方的物质主义发展道路，成为全球幸福治理的典范。
description_en: Bhutan Gross National Happiness (GNH) is an alternative development indicator to GDP, emphasizes spiritual happiness, environmental protection, cultural preservation, good governance, through constitutional guarantees, policy formulation, international promotion, explores development path different from Western materialism, becoming model for global happiness governance.
reason_zh: 不丹GNH幸福治理代表替代性发展指标如何重塑发展理念，展示了精神价值如何影响政策制定，其发展模式影响了全球可持续发展议程，其文化保护影响了传统与现代平衡，其国际倡导影响了幸福运动。
reason_en: Bhutan GNH happiness governance represents how alternative development indicators reshape development concepts, demonstrates how spiritual values influence policy making, its development model influences global sustainable development agenda, its cultural preservation influences tradition-modern balance, its international advocacy influences happiness movement.
steps_zh: 研究GNH理论框架/四大支柱/指标体系
分析宪法保障/政策制定/制度设计
探讨环境保护/文化保护/教育体系
评估国际影响/全球推广/经验分享
总结发展模式/幸福治理/未来前景
steps_en: Study GNH theoretical framework/four pillars/indicator system
expected_zh: 理解替代性发展指标如何重塑发展理念，掌握GNH幸福治理的核心价值，评估不丹发展模式的独特性，认识幸福治理在全球可持续发展中的作用。
expected_en: Understand how alternative development indicators reshape development concepts, grasp core values of GNH happiness governance, evaluate uniqueness of Bhutan development model, recognize happiness governance role in global sustainable development.
case_zh: 1972年GNH概念提出；2008年宪法确立；2012年全球会议。幸福治理/可持续发展/文化保护/政策创新。
case_en: 1972 GNH concept proposed; 2008 Constitution established; 2012 Global Conference. Happiness governance/Sustainable development/Cultural protection/Policy innovation.
cross_cultural_impact: Global development policy/Happiness movement/Environmental protection/Cultural diversity/Alternative governance
scientific_contribution: 是: 发展经济学/幸福研究
artistic_legacy: 是: 文化艺术/传统工艺
conflict_resolution_mechanism: 传统智慧/文化调解/和谐理念
